intro: Durable and practical, Auraline Ele embraces simplicity through a minimal design that fits seamlessly into modern spaces. With clean lines and functional organisation, it offers a storage solution that feels both practical and effortless.

features.title: A modern touch, sleek and bold
features.text: Riverside Riviera introduces a calm, sun-washed charm to the room. With pastel houses, drifting blossoms and a slow-turning Ferris wheel set against sky grey, it captures a city at ease and the textured finish adds a layer of warmth and elegance to your space.

features.title: Made to last with durable steel construction
features.text: Built with dent-resistant steel, this almirah is designed to protect your belongings while standing strong through years of daily use.

features.title: Spacious storage that keeps everything neat
features.text: Thoughtfully designed with shelves and drawers, this almirah ensures your belongings are organised and easily accessible whenever you need them.

features.title: Eco-friendly finish for lasting beauty
features.text: Coated with an eco-friendly powder finish, this almirah resists rust and wear, keeping it beautiful and functional for years to come.

features.title: Precision-crafted for a seamless experience
features.text: Designed with advanced manufacturing techniques, every detail of this almirah is built to make storage simple, hassle-free, and efficient.

name: Auraline Men Basic Digital Printed 2-Door Steel Almirah Riverside Riviera Sky Grey
